checks.explanation: No D-selection disclosure is present in the disclosures array, so the placement condition does not apply.
No item with category basic_services is priced in the items array, so the includesText adequacy test does not apply.
The list shows no second mandatory fee for facilities, overhead or staff beyond the basic services included in cremation and burial charges.
No D-embalming disclosure is present in the JSON, so the adjacency test does not apply.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket services.
The D-alt-container disclosure and the direct cremation prices both appear on page 1, which counts as immediate conjunction under the same-page rule.
Direct cremation is offered with an option for container provided by purchaser and no text says a casket is required for cremation.
The direct cremation includesText states the charge includes cremation itself and no separate crematory cash advance is listed.

checks.quote: Our charge for a direct cremation (without ceremony) includes: basic services of funeral director and staff; a proportionate share of overhead costs; removal of remains; transportation to crematory; necessary authorizations and cremation.
checks.explanation: Direct cremation and immediate burial are itemized, but forwarding remains and receiving remains are not listed as separate line items.
No optional package combining goods and services is present; direct cremation and immediate burial are required single-price items excluded from the package definition.
No statement asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires purchase of any item.
No text claims that any product preserves or protects the body long-term or delays decomposition.
No additional wording undercuts the required alternative-container disclosure and the disclosure appears on the same page as the prices.
